Today's free summary of "JUMBO BUCKS" ends here. Every number behind it is on this page.
1639.headline: What type of game it is

1640.body:
"MEGA BUCKS" has gone two weeks without a top prize claim, and tickets kept selling. Only a fixed number of tickets are printed. About a third of the tickets are sold, and every remaining $5 million prize is still unclaimed. That leaves the same top prizes among fewer tickets.

For "MEGA BUCKS" or any game, being late in a run is not automatically good or bad. The same numbers mean different things near the end of a run.

If you play "MEGA BUCKS" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
1640.headline: Top prizes are still unclaimed

1641.body:
About half of the tickets for "POWER 20X" have been sold. The game is about halfway through its run. The key question is whether the tickets or the top prizes run out first. Right now, tickets and top prizes are running out at about the same rate.

Every line of POWER 20X's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
1641.headline: Where this game is in its run

1642.body:
"$500,000 CASH BLITZ" has 55 of 60 top prizes left and is early in its run. About a quarter of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, neither the tickets nor the top prizes are running out faster than the other.

Every line of $500,000 CASH BLITZ's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
1642.headline: How much has sold

1643.body:
"WILD 9S" has fewer top prizes left. The count changed when one top prize of $9,000 was claimed two weeks ago. Unsold tickets still hold sixteen of the original eighteen. Check the top prize count first when you compare scratchers.

Everything here about "WILD 9S" comes from official Florida lottery numbers, current through October 15.
1643.headline: Fewer $9,000 prizes left

1644.body:
One of MONEY ROLL's top prizes was claimed in the latest numbers. A player in Florida won $50,000. The game started with six top prizes and now has five top prizes. Nothing bigger can change on a scratcher.

If you play "MONEY ROLL" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
1644.headline: A player won a top prize

1645.body:
"BLACK PEARLS" is down to three top prizes after a $1 million winner was claimed last week. The game started with four top prizes. Know that before you buy, because a change in top prizes changes the whole game.

The numbers for "BLACK PEARLS" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
1645.headline: Someone claimed a $1 million prize

1646.body:
$2,000,000 SPECTACULAR's prizes make it a game with most of its money in small, frequent prizes. Of the prize money still unclaimed, about three-quarters is in wins under $1,000. The prize counts change every day, but this design does not.

Six of $2,000,000 SPECTACULAR's six top prizes can still be won.

Every line of $2,000,000 SPECTACULAR's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
1646.headline: The prize mix in this game

1647.body:
"$15,000,000 PLATINUM PAYOUT" has had no $15 million top prize claimed since we started watching it. Everyday prizes keep getting claimed, and fewer tickets are left each day. The number of tickets printed is fixed. Each day without a top prize claim leaves those prizes among fewer tickets.

The most common prize left on "$15,000,000 PLATINUM PAYOUT" right now is $30.

The numbers for "$15,000,000 PLATINUM PAYOUT" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
1647.headline: Three weeks, no top prize claimed

5027.body:
"20X THE CASH" has 2,545,084 prizes of $2 still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $1,000 prize, with 1,073 left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

Everything above about "20X THE CASH" comes from the Florida Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
5027.headline: What's actually left to win

5048.body:
Most of the tickets for "FLORIDA 300X THE CASH" are sold. The top prize count has held, with one of four still unclaimed. The number of tickets printed is fixed, so that is a plain good sign.

The second-biggest prize left on "FLORIDA 300X THE CASH" is $1 million, with two of them remaining.

If "FLORIDA 300X THE CASH" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
5048.headline: No new top prize claims

5055.body:
"EMERALD MINE 9X" has one of ten top prizes left and is in the last part of its run. Most of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, neither the tickets nor the top prizes are running out faster than the other.

Today's free summary of "EMERALD MINE 9X" ends here. Every number behind it is on this page.
5055.headline: How far along this game is

5056.body:
"JEOPARDY" is in the second half of its run, with about a third of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, tickets and top prizes are running out at about the same rate.

The numbers for "JEOPARDY" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
5056.headline: Early stage or late

5057.body:
"EASY MONEY" has three of eight top prizes left and is past the halfway point of its run. About three-quarters of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, tickets are selling faster than top prizes are being claimed, which is good for the tickets that are left.

Every line of EASY MONEY's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
5057.headline: Tickets sold so far

5058.body:
Most of the tickets for "MILLIONAIRE MAKER" have been sold. The game is close to selling out. The key question is whether the tickets or the top prizes run out first. Right now, the top prizes and the tickets are going at about the same pace.

Tomorrow's count on "MILLIONAIRE MAKER" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
5058.headline: Where this game is in its run

5059.body:
About two-thirds of the tickets for "THE CASH WHEEL" have been sold. The game is well into its run. The key question is whether the tickets or the top prizes run out first. Right now, neither the tickets nor the top prizes are running out faster than the other.

Everything above about "THE CASH WHEEL" comes from the Florida Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
5059.headline: Where this game is in its run

5060.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "FIND THE 7S", about a quarter are still unsold. The game is near the end of its run, with zero of eight top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

The table below shows the full count for "FIND THE 7S", with every prize level included.
5060.headline: How much has sold

5063.body:
Of the unclaimed prize money on "CA$H IN HAND", most is in wins under $1,000. The game is a game with most of its money in small, frequent prizes. That is neither good nor bad, only how it was designed. Choose the kind of game that fits the win you want.

The numbers for "CA$H IN HAND" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
5063.headline: Same price, different prizes

7028.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "THE PERFECT GIFT", about half are still unsold. The game is near the midpoint of its run, with two of four top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

Tomorrow's count on "THE PERFECT GIFT" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
